title: The interplay between tissue-resident microbiome and host proteins by integrated multi-omics during progression of colorectal adenoma to carcinoma
data_scale: 185 tissue samples from 62 CRC/CRA patients; metagenomics+proteomics; 4057 bacterial/61 fungal/108 archaeal/374 viral species
contribution_type: multi-omics atlas + 14 microbial/8 protein diagnostic markers + 4 molecular subtypes
key_claim: Integrated multi-kingdom microbiome and host-protein profiling of the adenoma-carcinoma transition yields CRC-specific ecosystems and transferable biomarkers
opening_framing: Disease-burden hook: CRC is third most common cancer worldwide and rising in younger/low-income populations; early adenoma-stage detection critical

title: Unraveling interindividual variation of trimethylamine N-oxide and its precursors at the population level
data_scale: 7834 participants across 5 population cohorts; metabolites+genetics+diet+microbiome
contribution_type: population meta-analysis partitioning variance of a microbiome metabolite across data layers
key_claim: Choline not TMAO predicts cardiovascular risk; interindividual metabolite variation is driven by genetics diet and microbiota
opening_framing: Problem-gap hook: TMAO studied mostly in high-risk patients not the general population; variance drivers unknown

title: BIOME cohort: Multi-system microbiome dynamics and clinical outcomes in massive burn injury patients
data_scale: Multicenter prospective cohort; 50 hospitals across 28 provinces of China; skin/gut/oral/respiratory sampling
contribution_type: cohort-profile Letter establishing a nationwide longitudinal microbiome resource
key_claim: A nationwide multi-system microbiome cohort links post-burn dysbiosis to sepsis and mortality
opening_framing: Clinical-stakes hook: burns are leading injury mortality under 45; massive-burn sepsis is microbial-driven; no large multi-ecosystem cohort exists

title: Microbial DNA methylation links rumen transcriptional activity to methane emission divergence in dairy cows
data_scale: 264 Holstein cows screened; 15 high vs 15 low methane emitters; 491 species-level MAGs; ONT long-read methylome
contribution_type: first genome-resolved DNA-methylation atlas of a microbiome linked to a host phenotype
key_claim: Methane divergence is explained by microbial DNA-methylation and transcription not taxonomic abundance
opening_framing: Applied-stakes hook: enteric methane is a major greenhouse gas and energetic loss; taxonomy inconsistently explains it so a new framework is needed

title: Microbial keystone taxa and metabolic signatures in centenarians regulate intestinal homeostasis during aging
data_scale: Centenarian vs younger cohorts; co-occurrence network + metabolomics + mouse/cell validation
contribution_type: keystone-taxa framework moving from abundance to network position plus causal IAA-AHR mechanism
key_claim: Clostridium scindens is a centenarian keystone taxon whose IAA mitigates intestinal aging via AHR signaling
opening_framing: Demographic hook: WHO projects 2.1 billion people over 60 by 2050; dysbiosis is an aging hallmark; abundance-based studies miss keystone taxa

title: Duck gut metagenome reveals the microbiome signatures linked to intestinal regional temporal development and rearing condition
data_scale: First duck gut gene catalog (24 million genes) and 4437 MAGs across regions/ages/rearing
contribution_type: reference catalog + signature discovery for an undersampled host
key_claim: A comprehensive duck gut gene catalog maps regional temporal and rearing-condition microbiome signatures
opening_framing: Economic hook: China holds a quarter of global poultry; duck gut understudied vs chicken; regional/temporal structure unknown

title: Wekemo Bioincloud: A user-friendly platform for meta-omics data analyses
data_scale: Deployed cloud platform; demonstration datasets
contribution_type: software/resource description of an analysis platform
key_claim: A user-friendly cloud platform unifies meta-omics workflows from raw data to statistics
opening_framing: Tool-need hook: surge of meta-omics data demands robust yet user-friendly analysis tools

title: MetOrigin 2.0: Advancing the discovery of microbial metabolites and their origins
data_scale: Seven integrated metabolite databases; ~4000 jobs/month; 1800+ users; pediatric-obesity case study
contribution_type: major-version tool upgrade with new analytic modules
key_claim: MetOrigin 2.0 adds three analytical modes and eight modules to trace microbial metabolite origins
opening_framing: Adoption hook: established tool processing 4000 jobs/month for 1800 users now upgraded to meet growing demand

title: MDIPID: Microbiota-drug interaction and disease phenotype interrelation database
data_scale: 6669 drug-modulation, 11760 microbiota-variation, 15146 microbiota-disease records; 2708 species 1818 drugs 482 diseases
contribution_type: curated interconnected database filling a resource gap
key_claim: MDIPID is the first resource to jointly capture microbiota-drug-disease bidirectional interactions and microbial proteins
opening_framing: Gap hook: no existing resource comprehensively describes microbiota-drug-disease bidirectional interactions for precision medicine

title: ggClusterNet 2: An R package for microbial co-occurrence networks and associated indicator correlation patterns
data_scale: Used in 300+ studies; example multi-omics/transkingdom datasets
contribution_type: major-version package upgrade for complex designs
key_claim: ggClusterNet 2 extends co-occurrence network analysis to multi-factor transkingdom and multi-network designs
opening_framing: Adoption hook: original package used in 300+ studies now upgraded for emerging multi-factor and transkingdom challenges

title: MASH-Ocean 1.0: Interactive platform for investigating microbial diversity function and biogeography with marine metagenomic data
data_scale: Integrated global marine metagenomes; diversity/function/biogeography/network modules
contribution_type: standardized atlas-platform for biogeography of marine microbiomes
key_claim: MASH-Ocean standardizes interactive analysis of massive marine metagenomes and maps C/N/S cycling microbes
opening_framing: Scale hook: oceans are the largest biosphere habitat but each study uses different tools making data hard to integrate

title: MASS cohort: Multicenter longitudinal and prospective study of the role of microbiome in severe pneumonia and host susceptibility
data_scale: 2000 ICU patients; 19 hospitals across 10 cities in 3 provinces; multi-site longitudinal sampling
contribution_type: cohort-profile establishing a multicenter clinical resource
key_claim: A 2000-patient ICU cohort links lung and gut microbiome dynamics to severe pneumonia susceptibility
opening_framing: Clinical hook: severe pneumonia burden motivates a large multicenter microbiome cohort

title: Spinal cord injury induces acute microbiome shock and system-wide transcriptomic reprogramming
data_scale: Multi-timepoint gut microbiome + multi-organ transcriptome; open-access atlas (SCIGAMA)
contribution_type: phenomenon discovery + released atlas resource
key_claim: Spinal cord injury triggers a rapid reversible microbiome shock with system-wide transcriptomic reprogramming
opening_framing: Phenomenon hook: systemic consequences of spinal cord injury on gut microbiome are uncharacterized

title: Microbiome and aging: Trajectories of microbiome age across human ecosystems and their systemic effects
data_scale: Synthesis across gut/oral/skin/urogenital ecosystems
contribution_type: framework/review of a cross-niche biosignature
key_claim: A cross-ecosystem microbiome-age gap predicts healthspan and disease risk
opening_framing: Concept hook: microbiome age is emerging as a systemic biosignature converging across niches toward dysbiosis

title: Comprehensive lung microbial gene and genome catalogs assist the mechanism survey of Mesomycoplasma hyopneumoniae strains causing pig lung lesions
data_scale: 744 metagenomes from 675 pigs; 10.03 million-gene catalog (44.8% novel); 356 MAGs
contribution_type: reference catalog enabling mechanistic follow-up
key_claim: A largest-to-date lung microbial gene catalog identifies a pathogen MAG and virulence factors behind pig lung lesions
opening_framing: Sampling-gap hook: lower respiratory tract microbiome understudied due to hard sampling

title: Isolation of potentially novel species expands the genomic and functional diversity of Lachnospiraceae
data_scale: 1868 high-quality genomes; 387 species-level clusters; public + new isolates
contribution_type: genomic resource + geography/habitat-structured functional analysis
key_claim: Taxonomy, habitat and geography together shape Lachnospiraceae functional diversity relevant to ACVD and IBD
opening_framing: Resource-gap hook: Lachnospiraceae diversity poorly delineated hampering probiotic strain selection

title: Single-microbe RNA sequencing uncovers unexplored specialized metabolic functions of keystone species in the human gut
data_scale: 3 healthy donors (distinct enterotypes); 38922 single microbes across 198 species
contribution_type: new method + single-microbe transcriptional atlas
key_claim: Single-microbe RNA-seq reveals species-function heterogeneity and diurnal activity in the gut microbiome
opening_framing: Method-gap hook: gut microbiome understanding still rests on taxonomy/gene abundance missing single-cell function

title: Serum metabolic and microbial profiling yields insights into promoting effect of tryptophan-related metabolites for health longevity in centenarians
data_scale: 425 volunteers incl. 145 centenarians (100-120y); gut+oral microbiota + serum metabolome
contribution_type: population profiling across age/longevity strata
key_claim: Distinct centenarian, longevity-family and aging signatures link tryptophan metabolites to healthy longevity
opening_framing: Longevity hook: characterizing centenarian metabolites/microbiota informs healthy-longevity mechanisms

title: Gut microbiome and metabolome characteristics of patients with cholesterol gallstones suggest the preventive potential of prebiotics
data_scale: 191 samples 16S + 60 metagenome/metabolome (30 CGS vs 30 matched) + mouse intervention
contribution_type: biomarker discovery + causal mouse validation
key_claim: Gut microbial and metabolite biomarkers of cholesterol gallstones point to prebiotic prevention
opening_framing: Unmet-need hook: cholesterol gallstones lack noninvasive treatment and etiology is underexplored

title: A comprehensive analysis of antibiotic resistance genes in the giant panda gut
data_scale: Giant-panda gut MAG database; captive vs wild; 1217 ARGs shared with human gut
contribution_type: resource + resistome characterization
key_claim: A giant-panda gut MAG database maps ARG reservoirs and human-shared resistance genes
opening_framing: Conservation hook: antimicrobial resistance threatens public health and an endangered species

title: Bioprospecting of culturable marine biofilm bacteria for novel antimicrobial peptides
data_scale: 713 strains + near-complete genomes; 80430 sORFs; 341 candidate AMPs; 54/60 synthesized active
contribution_type: deep-learning discovery pipeline + validated resource
key_claim: Ribosome-profiling plus deep learning discovers novel active antimicrobial peptides from marine biofilms
opening_framing: Antibiotic hook: AMPs are a viable source of novel antibiotics against drug-resistant pathogens

title: Gut Enterococcus faecium derived leucic acid mediates the antiobesity effect of dietary fiber
data_scale: Fecal metagenomic data mining + clinical cohort validation + mouse mechanism
contribution_type: data-mining-to-mechanism discovery
key_claim: E. faecium-derived leucic acid mediates the antiobesity effect of dietary fiber glucomannan
opening_framing: Disease hook: obesity is globally prevalent and tied to dysbiosis but microbial mechanisms unclear

title: Strain level variation in pathogenic invaders alters rhizosphere communities
data_scale: Cross-pathogen meta-analysis + 30 R. solanacearum strains x 51 traits
contribution_type: meta-analysis + trait-based prediction
key_claim: Functional trait dissimilarity (67.9% of variance) predicts how pathogen strains reshape resident microbiota
opening_framing: Mechanism hook: pathogen invasion disrupts microbiota but strain-level drivers are unclear

title: The rheumatoid arthritis gut microbial biobank reveals core microbial species that associate and effect on host inflammation and autoimmune responses
data_scale: 3200 isolates; 601 strains / 280 species (43 novel) from RA patients; mouse validation
contribution_type: cultured-strain resource + core-microbiome + causal mouse test
key_claim: A deposited RA gut biobank covers 93.2% of medium/high-abundance species and defines an inflammatory core microbiome
opening_framing: Causality hook: metagenomic RA studies lack cultured strains needed for mechanism and causality

title: Enhancing human gut health: Global innovations in dysbiosis management
data_scale: 20 years of global dysbiosis patent literature
contribution_type: global landscape/trend analysis of a field
key_claim: A 20-year patent landscape maps global innovation trends in dysbiosis management
opening_framing: Translation hook: dysbiosis management is a globally active innovation space worth systematically surveying
